title: Shiv Sena UBT crisis LIVE: Sanjay Raut hurls abuses at suspected rebel MPs; new twist in rebellion drama
description: Shiv Sena UBT news LIVE: Amid rebellion crisis in Mamata's TMC, Uddhav Thackeray is also staring at a split in his Shiv Sena with buzz of six of nine MPs planning to form a breakaway group. Amid the split buzz, Uddhav backer Sanjay Raut said rebel MPs have been offered ₹50 crore.
